map_role: Sibling 04 — interleaved dirty-keel receiving, rotor-grading, inhabited worker quarantine and bonded export
macro_topology: Three unequal, interleaved industrial courts: low curved keel receiving to the west; peaked circular rotor-grader at centre; serrated enclosed bonded-quarantine court at east. A small inhabited ledger/service hub and fragmented lower recovery line mediate the transitions.
density_profile: Three highly distinct clustered machine silhouettes separated by very large intentionally editable sky and low service voids; small lower habitation/custody quarters retain partly unfurnished rooms.

route_grammar.main: Western lift apron → open strip/clamp approach → Grading air lane → grading exchange → worker hub → entered quarantine registry → east dispatch
route_grammar.alternate: Wide upper sky above the low receiving canopy, tall rotor gable and serrated quarantine roof; multiple branch/rejoin choices around supported shafts
route_grammar.lower: Separate left and right anchored relief accesses and several partly interrupted subterranean transfer/maintenance galleries; recovery into the main flight volume through real entered apertures
route_grammar.obstruction: Temporary physical 95×96-cell occupancy barrier [1700,670,95,96] interrupts quarantine registry → interview shortest 31×27 flight path, lengthening it from 271 to 357 cardinal steps without losing any of 29 named sites

strong_motifs: Unequal zigzag intake canopy with broad double-rib broken-keel cradle and actual receiving trays
Tall peaked lifting/rotor grading hall with two grounded concentric steel arcs and rooted load paths
Low staggered inhabited work hub with entered uneven openings and stepped custody counters
Asymmetric serrated quarantine roof with nested receiving arches and a protected export porch
Deep founded concrete posts, pale steel trays and black editable high-volume negative space
interesting_relationships: Reclaimed hull rests inside a double-curved clamp on supported receiving floor and feeds a side transfer to grading
Circular grading rotor is rooted through a load-bearing shaft and directly adjacent to a narrow crew exchange
Short service hub mediates rather than duplicates the two very different great industrial courts
A real 31×27-body obstruction between registry and quarantine interview changes the selected cardinal path while leaving alternate access
Deliberately broken eastern annex is an uncompleted modular continuation, not an omitted gameplay prerequisite

Unfitted west salvage and central rotor equipment sockets for manual SWARM/GENTEK stroke authoring

procedural_exemplar_value: Tests clustered unlike industrial machine silhouettes joined by a small inhabited interface, arch/ring vs jagged canopy load path, fractured export edge and original single-grid alternative-route proof. Useful as independent structural-parts, district-transition and example-derived grammar training geometry.
similarity_avoidance: Avoids Keelbone 01/02 opposed rock shoulders and central void, Keelbone 03's repeated identical U-frame roof bays, Tidefault's isolated custody stilts, and the anchor donors' vessel/tipper/drydock contours, exact routes, coordinates and pixel streams. Family resemblance is industrial supports and freight transactions, not a copied spatial template.
